No forward references and no post-5a item/page changes existed, so no other verdict was owed.
- **Impact classifications** (verified by byte comparison, not assumption): 570 new in-window items (all with hash-current 5a decision rows), 589 publication/audit-stamp-only items (only `status:`/`verification:` differ from the pre-edit backups), 3 authorized published repairs. All 304 untouched affected consumers are guard-hash-identical to the pre-author snapshot. All 1298 dispositions are `still-licensed`; no item was repaired, struck, dropped or reverted, so no `5b-cross` ledger row and no `defect_ids` cell exists.
